name: Greater mana draught
description: A bottle of bright, restless blue. It hums in a way that makes the candles lean away.
notes: A greater mana potion (mw-ju8.4), buy and use only: no brewing yet. Restores 100 mana; the minor tier is the existing mana draught at 30. Base value 90 sits in the economy greater potion band. Magnitudes are a placeholder scale for the balance tool.
